items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: My little boy sings now. Don't forget to put him down.

ctx.x: Nice to meet you. And what do you play? I play a clarinet. I see. And how old are you? 14. You're 14. Can you fake? Yes, sir. You can fake and read both, huh? Can you read? Yes, sir.
Oh, well that's wonderful. My little boy sings now. Don't forget to put him down.

Where is that? Let me get Sammy Lee. Let me get Sammy. Sammy Lee, huh? That's right. Sammy Lee Thomas. Okay. Well now we'll just start asking personal questions right away. That's right. Are you older than Billy or younger?
